metadata.description: Record of all substantive decisions (keep/integrate/archive/discard) with evidence-based justification

decisions.target: All source code and configuration files (src/, config files)
decisions.justification: Core functionality is clean, functional, and production-ready. Code follows React best practices, uses modern tooling, and implements intended features correctly.
decisions.impact_notes: Preserves all working functionality; provides solid foundation for future development

decisions.justification: Resolve contradiction C1: Repository name suggests full service, but code is only a landing page. Users may be confused about repository purpose.
decisions.impact_notes: Prevents user confusion; sets correct expectations; improves onboarding
action_items: Add note after README.md line 3: 'This repository contains the **landing page** for an AI educational tools service. It is a marketing/informational site, not the service implementation itself.'

decisions.justification: Resolve contradiction C2: Extreme printWidth value (99999999) is unusual and undocumented. Need to either document rationale or normalize to standard value (80-120).
decisions.impact_notes: Improves code style clarity for collaborators; maintains consistency
action_items: Consult with repository owner about rationale
OPTION A: Document reason in README if intentional for LLM workflows
OPTION B: Normalize to standard value (recommend 100) if no strong reason exists

decisions.justification: Resolve contradiction C4: Dual workflow model (GPT Engineer sync + manual git) risks merge conflicts. Must clarify primary workflow and warn against mixing approaches.
decisions.impact_notes: Prevents merge conflicts; provides clear contribution path; reduces friction
action_items: Add 'Development Workflow' section to README before 'Setup'
Document OPTION A: GPT Engineer sync (AI-assisted)
Document OPTION B: Traditional git workflow
Add warning: 'Do not mix both workflows without coordination'
Specify which is primary (recommend Option B for open-source collaboration)

decisions.justification: Functional containerized development environment; provides consistent setup across machines; good practice for team development.
decisions.impact_notes: Enables consistent dev environment; supports multiple development methods

decisions.justification: Standard React linting setup with appropriate plugins (react, react-hooks, react-refresh); enforces code quality.
decisions.impact_notes: Maintains code quality standards; catches common errors

decisions.justification: Current .gitignore is minimal (dist, node_modules, .env.local, .DS_Store). Adding IDE patterns improves developer experience and prevents accidental commits of IDE config files.
decisions.impact_notes: Improves developer experience; prevents IDE config pollution in commits

decisions.justification: No contribution guidelines exist. If opening to collaborators, need clear documentation on workflow, code style, PR process, especially given dual workflow model (C4).
decisions.impact_notes: Enables open-source collaboration; reduces friction for new contributors; clarifies expectations

decisions.justification: No historical documentation exists. Important to document that repo was GPT Engineer-generated on 2024-02-22; establishes baseline for future historical tracking.
decisions.impact_notes: Provides context for future developers; documents architectural decisions; supports onboarding

decisions.justification: No changelog exists; only one commit so far. Useful for tracking future changes, releases, and deprecations as project evolves.
decisions.impact_notes: Supports release management; helps users track what changed between versions

decisions.justification: Repository is in initial state with no legacy content, obsolete branches, or deprecated features to archive.
All code is current and functional; no redundant, obsolete, or superseded content exists.

phase_1_critical.description: Immediate actions required before next development iteration
action_summary: D2: Update README.md with scope clarification (landing page, not service)
D4: Document primary development workflow in README.md

phase_2_short_term.description: Actions to complete in next sprint
action_summary: D3: Review prettier configuration; document or normalize
D8: Review and integrate created CONTRIBUTING.md
D9: Review and integrate created PROJECT_HISTORY.md
D10: Initialize CHANGELOG.md for version tracking

key_recommendations: Focus on D2 and D4 immediately - these prevent user confusion and workflow conflicts
Review created documentation files (D8, D9) and integrate into repository
Consider D3 (prettier config) in next sprint
Defer D7 and D10 (gitignore, changelog) until more active development begins
